title.narrative: Banco de Bogotá: Loan to Support MSMEs and Projects with an Environmental and Social Emphasis in Colombia

description.narrative: The project consists of supporting Banco de Bogotá with a senior debt facility of up to US$150 million, structured as follows: (i) Committed Tranche I Loan, of up to US$40 million, to be financed by IDBInvest, aimed at promoting the financing of Micro, Small, and Medium-Sized Enterprises (“MSMEs”) and projects with an Environmental and Social (“E&S”) emphasis; (ii)Committed Tranche II Loan, of up to US$10 million, to finance competitive transformation projects; and (iii) Uncommitted A Loan, up to US$20 million, to promote financing for MSMEs and projects with an E&S emphasis. Additionally, the A Loan will be complemented by a loan of approximately US$80 million to be financed by other investors. The tenor of each loan will be up to three years from disbursement, with principal repayment at maturity.
